lines.text: The people of Israel argued that Absalom, whom they had anointed, had died in battle, so they should restore the king.
David told the priests to ask the elders of Ephraim why they were last to restore him, and to promise Amasa Joab's place.
The men of Judah told the king to return, and they came to Gilgal to escort him across the Jordan.
Shimei son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with two thousand men of Benjamin and fell before the king.
Abishai wanted Shimei put to death for cursing the LORD's anointed, but David told Shimei he would not die.
